words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens 72:7 as continuation, not as a detached oath or free-standing assertion. It keeps the denial inside the serial testimony of the jinn, so the false assumption becomes one more disclosed item in the accumulating report. The connector also carries the reader across the boundary from the refuge scene in 72:6 into the belief that helps explain it. Because the sound moves immediately into {{ar:أَنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:annahum}}) and then {{ar:ظَنُّوا۟}} ({{tr:ẓannū}}), the light connective opening quickly enters the denser texture of reported assumption.

The accepted {{ar:وَإِنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:wa-innahum}}) variant usefully shows how the same material can press toward direct emphatic diagnosis, while the aligned surface here remains embedded in the testimony chain. The word therefore combines clause status and group identity in one compact opening.

words.prose: {{ar:ظَنُّوا۟}} ({{tr:ẓannū}}) names the group's assumption as a completed past state now being exposed. It is not vague thinking, because the following {{ar:أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ}} ({{tr:an lan yabʿatha}}) gives the exact content: a confident denial of divine raising. The root range can move from conjecture to firm expectation, and the local {{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}) clause pulls it toward culpable false certainty. Form I keeps the act with the group itself, while the plural suffix keeps collective responsibility inside the word. The first {{ar:ظَنُّوا۟}} ({{tr:ẓannū}}) also launches the mirrored frame completed by {{ar:ظَنَنتُمْ}} ({{tr:ẓanantum}}), so the error is heard as shared cognition before its content is named. The wider contrast is not generic: 53:28 sets supposition against truth, 83:4 makes raising the point of failure, and 72:12 later reworks the same assumption-negation frame toward corrected recognition. Its doubled and repeated n-sounds thicken the move from hidden belief to negation, carrying the reader from the outward burden of 72:6 into the inward judgment behind it.

words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) is the hinge that makes one group's thought a mirror for another's. It does not merely place two assumptions side by side; it measures {{ar:ظَنُّوا۟}} ({{tr:ẓannū}}) by what the addressees themselves thought. Fused with {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) in {{ar:كَمَا}} ({{tr:kamā}}), it makes the second thought grammatically dependent on the first and prepares the turn toward {{ar:ظَنَنتُمْ}} ({{tr:ẓanantum}}). The particle also keeps the repeated root from becoming bare repetition: the echo is interpreted as likeness.

words.prose: {{ar:ظَنَنتُمْ}} ({{tr:ẓanantum}}) completes the mirror by turning reported error into direct address. The suffix makes the addressees part of the verb itself, so they are not spectators to another group's mistake. Like {{ar:ظَنُّوا۟}} ({{tr:ẓannū}}), it is perfect, matching two completed cognitive states; unlike the first verb, it points at the hearers. The following {{ar:أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ}} ({{tr:an lan yabʿatha}}) supplies the shared content, so the second verb needs no separate object. The root's range can support reverent expectation in 2:46, but here the negated baʿth clause selects distorted expectation: a communal forecast that divine raising would not occur. Within the surah, this addressed form sits between mistaken speech about God in 72:5 and corrected recognition in 72:12, while its n-sounds carry the mirror into the following subordination and negation.

words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) pivots from mirrored cognition into the proposition both sides assumed. It makes {{ar:لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا}} ({{tr:lan yabʿatha allāhu aḥadan}}) the precise content of the thought, so the ayah separates the act of assuming from what was assumed. The particle also nominalizes and projects the clause: the denied event is held inside their belief, not narrated as fact. Because it is immediately followed by {{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}), subordination and future negation are stacked before the verb appears.

words.prose: {{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}) places the believed content under future negation and governs {{ar:يَبْعَثَ}} ({{tr:yabʿatha}}) as subjunctive. The force is not only that the speakers thought resurrection had not happened; they projected God's act forward as unavailable. Debates over whether the particle is simply future negation or intensified foreclosure remain useful, but the local clause makes the overconfident effect unmistakable. Because {{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}) comes before both the action and {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}), the false impossibility is heard before the agent whose power it restricts, and its scope reaches the final {{ar:أَحَدًا}} ({{tr:aḥadan}}). The doubled sound in the particle gives the negation a compressed weight inside the same n-heavy chain as the two cognition verbs.

words.prose: {{ar:يَبْعَثَ}} ({{tr:yabʿatha}}) is the denied act at the center of the content clause. Its subjunctive form is governed by {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) and {{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}), so baʿth appears inside their false projected future. The verb is active and transitive: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) is the explicit subject and {{ar:أَحَدًا}} ({{tr:aḥadan}}) the object, making the denial a claim about God's agency toward any possible individual. That active frame also blocks a self-rising reading: the movement depends on the divine subject rather than on the raised object springing up by itself. The {{ar:ب ع ث}} ({{tr:b-ʿ-th}}) field holds raising, awakening, stirring into motion, and dispatch; locally that breadth intensifies the mistake while the grammar keeps divine resurrection-agency in view. The denied act is answered by sleepers being awakened in 18:19 and graves being raised in 22:7, so the root's dormancy-to-activity field is not abstract background. The verb arrives before the named subject, so the action is heard first and then attached to the agent whose power the assumption forecloses.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) fills the agency slot of the denied act. It is nominative as the explicit subject of {{ar:يَبْعَثَ}} ({{tr:yabʿatha}}), so the assumption is not about an impersonal cycle but about what God will not do. The proper name, rather than a pronoun or generic deity term, makes the agent fully definite and forces the denial to face the named divine actor. The root and name field keeps divinity and worship pressure present, with the refuge-turning association especially sharp after 72:6's failed refuge scene; locally, however, the surface is the proper name of the acting subject. The same divine agency denied here is affirmed for raising in 22:7 and corrected within the surah's recognition of inescapable divine power in 72:12. Placed between {{ar:يَبْعَثَ}} ({{tr:yabʿatha}}) and {{ar:أَحَدًا}} ({{tr:aḥadan}}), the name structurally centers divine agency between denied action and universal object-scope, and recitational liaison keeps the verb-to-subject relation joined rather than isolated.

words.prose: {{ar:أَحَدًا}} ({{tr:aḥadan}}) is the object where the denial lands. It is accusative under {{ar:يَبْعَثَ}} ({{tr:yabʿatha}}), so anyone is not a loose adjunct but the patient of the denied act. Its singular indefinite form under {{ar:لَّن}} ({{tr:lan}}) gives the claim granular scope: not one possible individual is left outside the negation. The word is unsuffixed and open-ended, so it avoids routing to a named antecedent. The singularity field also contrasts creaturely anyone here with divine uniqueness in 112:1 and with worship-partner exclusion in 72:18. Ending the ayah on {{ar:أَحَدًا}} ({{tr:aḥadan}}) lets universal negative scope land last, after action and divine agent have already been named; the final -an nasal closure seals that scope in sound as well as grammar.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ظن in ظنوا كما ظننتم and the categorical future negation أن لن.
baseline_models.mechanism: The comparative كما makes one group's forecast mirror another's. Read through the uncertain-supposition branch, the agreement is social replication rather than independent confirmation, while لن overstates that weak basis as an unlimited future denial.

activation_trace.role: The branch's suspicion or uncertain supposition makes the two mirrored judgments a weakly grounded categorical forecast.

changed_reading.before: They believed that God would never raise or send anyone.
changed_reading.after: They repeat each other's conjecture and convert shared uncertainty into the categorical claim that God will never raise or send anyone.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same two ظن forms can carry strong conviction based on an indication, not only doubt.
baseline_models.mechanism: A competing focus-only reading treats both groups as convinced by what they took to be signs. كما then marks convergent certainty: their error may be a confident inference from inadequate indicators rather than a casual guess.

activation_trace.role: The branch's certainty after an indication supplies an evidence-claim that has hardened into conviction.

changed_reading.before: They merely guessed that no one would be raised or sent.
changed_reading.after: They regarded available indications as sufficient proof that God would never raise or commission anyone.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يبعث with the unrestricted object أحدا under لن.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus verb spans rousing a still thing and dispatching a directed agent. The exhaustive object keeps both mechanisms live: the denied act may be revival from stillness, commissioning an envoy, or more broadly any divinely initiated mobilization.

activation_trace.role: Rousing a still thing into motion supplies the revival pole of the denied divine act.
Dispatching and directing an agent supplies the commissioning pole of the denied divine act.
The negative exhaustive anyone extends the denial across every possible patient or envoy.

changed_reading.after: God will never set even one being in motion or dispatch even one directed agent, with resurrection and mission both still live.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular-looking أحدا occurs inside a categorical negation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negative exhaustive branch prevents the object from meaning only one notable person, while the individual-by-individual branch gives the denial distributive force. No isolated exception is allowed to break the speakers' claimed closure.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive anyone makes the negation universal rather than merely singular.
Individual-by-individual separation makes every possible exception fail separately.

changed_reading.before: They deny that an unspecified person will be raised or sent.
changed_reading.after: They claim a closure with no possible individual exception: not anyone at all will be raised or sent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus formula sits between two first-person uses of ظننا أن لن. The earlier judgment trusts that humans and jinn would not speak falsely about God; the later judgment recognizes that God cannot be frustrated or escaped. The repeated frame therefore traces recalibration rather than a fixed confidence level, and كما identifies the focus error as transmissible between communities.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain supposition supplies the focus claim's revisable epistemic state.
The earlier uncertain supposition models misplaced trust in inherited speakers and exposes the same frame as corrigible.
Certainty after an indication supplies the later, experience-backed recognition that escape is impossible.

structural_cues: 72:5, 72:7, and 72:12 repeat the construction ظن plus أن لن while changing speaker and proposition.
The focus alone adds كما, explicitly linking one group's judgment to another's.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated frame and the movement from false-speaker trust to recognized inability to escape; I infer an epistemic correction in which encounter recalibrates ظن. A live alternative is that all three uses denote strong belief and only their propositions differ.

changed_reading.before: The verse labels one false belief about raising or sending.
changed_reading.after: The verse catches a socially copied stage in a sequence of belief revision: an untested categorical forecast is later replaced by conviction grounded in encountered limits.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revelation is heard, the heard discourse guides, and a chosen رسول appears within a chain of رسالات. These context mechanisms instantiate directed communication through an envoy, activating the dispatch branch of يبعث without erasing its revival sense.

activation_trace.role: Dispatching and directing an agent turns the focus verb toward commissioning an envoy.
A report or inspiration from God supplies the transmitted content that requires a directed communication path.
A gracious dispatch or gift gives the heard guidance the functional shape of a beneficent mission.
Sending and setting forth supplies the explicit envoy mechanism that matches the focus verb's dispatch branch.

structural_cues: 72:1-2 moves from revelation to hearing to guidance.
72:23 and 72:27-28 explicitly place messages and a selected messenger inside a protected delivery chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine communication, guiding content, and an explicitly sent messenger; I infer that these realize one live sense of the focus بعث. The materially live alternative is that يبعث in 72:7 refers only to resurrection while messenger language merely disproves the wider worldview.

changed_reading.before: They deny only that God will resurrect anyone.
changed_reading.after: They also deny that God will commission any envoy, a denial overturned by the revelation-guidance-messenger chain surrounding their speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus claim, the speakers probe a boundary and find an active security arrangement: guarding and watchfulness now occupy former listening stations. The scene gives concrete motion and deployment to what the focus categorically denies, so the claim is destabilized by an encountered mobilization before its final referent is settled.

activation_trace.role: Rousing a still thing into motion supplies the focus-side image of a previously quiet order becoming active.
Dispatching directed agents lets the guarded boundary function as a mobilized response.
Seeking or probing supplies an active test of the inherited claim rather than another report.
Finding and encountering supplies the empirical result of that probe.
Protection and guarding supply the deployed enforcement function discovered at the boundary.
Watchful surveillance makes the new boundary arrangement continuously active rather than momentary.

structural_cues: 72:8 follows the denial with a first-person probe and discovery.
72:9 contrasts former sitting places with the present marker الآن and an immediate finding by any listener.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies probing, discovery, guards, and surveillance; I infer that the altered boundary is evidence of divine mobilization and may image the focus verb's rousing or dispatch. A live alternative is that the security scene only signals changed access and is not itself an instance of يبعث.

changed_reading.before: Their denial concerns a remote future act with no present test.
changed_reading.after: Their denial is already under pressure from a present, discoverable mobilization of the cosmic boundary: the supposedly inactive order has become guarded and watchful.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus turns uncertainty about outcome into لن, an unlimited never. Later context instead presents something promised that will be seen, then withholds whether it is near or assigned a longer endpoint. The temporal mechanism reverses the inference: an unknown schedule does not license denial of occurrence.

activation_trace.role: An outcome that cannot be relied on supplies the uncertainty that the speakers improperly convert into never.
Rousing from stillness keeps a future raising available as the event whose schedule is disputed.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies eventual verification against the earlier forecast.
An appointment bounded by time or place supplies a scheduled event despite undisclosed timing.
Temporal nearness makes proximity, not existence, the open question.
An endpoint or terminus supplies the alternative of a divinely set longer horizon.

structural_cues: 72:24 uses حتى إذا and seeing to place the promised matter ahead of the speakers.
72:25 contrasts near with an assigned term instead of contrasting occurrence with non-occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies eventual seeing, promise, temporal nearness, and an endpoint; I infer that these correct the focus conversion of unknown timing into non-occurrence. The promised matter could be punishment or defeat rather than bodily resurrection, so the raising sense is strengthened but not forced.

changed_reading.before: They conclude that a future raising will never happen.
changed_reading.after: They mistake an undisclosed timetable for impossibility; context replaces never with a promised event whose proximity or term remains unknown.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus speakers issue a categorical forecast about a divine future act. The closing context locates that future within concealed knowledge, permits disclosure only by divine selection, and ends with comprehensive enumeration. The mistake therefore becomes jurisdictional as well as propositional: the speakers close a domain whose disclosure and count they do not control.

activation_trace.role: Certainty after an indication supplies the speakers' claim to know the future from signs available to them.
The uncovering of a thing to a knower establishes knowledge as access rather than confident repetition.
Concealment from eyes defines the future domain as unavailable to ordinary inspection.
Emergence and disclosure supply the controlled exception by which concealed knowledge can become manifest.
Enumeration by exhaustive reckoning supplies the closing contrast to the speakers' unsupported closure.

structural_cues: 72:26 names the knower of the unseen and negates disclosure to anyone.
72:27 supplies a selected-messenger exception, while 72:28 closes with encompassing knowledge and exhaustive count.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed knowledge, controlled disclosure, and exhaustive reckoning; I infer that the focus claim trespasses an epistemic boundary by predicting what God will never do. A live alternative is that the verse condemns only the forecast's content, not the speakers' authority to forecast.

changed_reading.before: They make an incorrect prediction about divine action.
changed_reading.after: They claim unauthorized certainty over a concealed future, closing off divine action in a domain whose disclosure and exhaustive knowledge belong to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repetitions of أحد under negation distribute 'anyone' across worship, association, protection, and access to the unseen. At the same time a messenger remains possible. This separates a commissioned individual from a rival possessor or protector: being sent by God does not grant shared divine agency.

activation_trace.role: Dispatching a directed person supplies the legitimate commissioned role that context distinguishes from divine ownership.
Exhaustive anyone initially appears to eliminate every possible commissioned person.
The repeated exhaustive anyone applies universal negation specifically to protection from God.
Ownership and power of disposal define the capacity explicitly denied to the speaking messenger.
Protective asylum supplies the substitute-saving role that no individual can provide against God.
Turning toward a refuge supplies the escape role denied alongside personal protection.

structural_cues: 72:18, 72:20, 72:22, and 72:26 repeat أحدا or أحد in distinct negative constructions.
72:21-22 deny the messenger control of harm, guidance, protection, and refuge; 72:27 still names a selected messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated exhaustive negation across different roles and a messenger with explicitly bounded power; I infer a deliberate distinction between commission and divinization. The alternative is that the repeated أحد is only rhetorical cohesion and does not rescope the focus object.

changed_reading.before: They deny that any individual can be sent.
changed_reading.after: They fail to distinguish a divinely commissioned individual from an independent rival or protector: context allows the envoy while denying that envoy any share of divine ownership or refuge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the offspring-hoped-for branch of ظن is specialized and not the ordinary verbal sense here. It remains anchored because that focus branch, the dispatch branch of يبعث, and the immediately preceding denial of a resulting offspring create a visible contrast between generation and commission. Downstream prose should state explicitly that the context rejects divine begetting and present this only as a contrastive activation, never as an offspring reading of the focus verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The specialized offspring expectation branch of focus ظن beside focus يبعث and the nearby ولا ولدا.

activation_trace.role: The specialized image of a woman from whom offspring is hoped activates an expectation-of-progeny contrast.
Dispatch and direction supply a non-genealogical way for an individual to proceed from divine initiative.
Something produced or newly resulting from another supplies the generative relation that context explicitly negates.

changed_reading.before: The verse denies resurrection or mission without regard to kinship.
changed_reading.after: As a contained contrast, the surrounding discourse separates begetting from dispatch: any envoy would be commissioned by God, not generated as divine kin.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because exhaustive counting at the surah's close does not itself entail resurrection. It remains valid as a formal echo: the focus denies even one separately considered individual, while the close reckons every item without residue. Downstream prose should call it a distributive or census-like resonance, not proof that 72:28 names the raising event.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus أحدا under negation, especially its individual-by-individual branch, as the object of يبعث.

activation_trace.role: Individual-by-individual distribution turns the denied anyone into separately considered units.
Rousing the still supplies the possible action denied of every such unit.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies a closing mechanism in which no unit escapes reckoning.
Counting the counted supplies the explicit unit-by-unit form of that comprehensive reckoning.

changed_reading.before: أحدا is only an idiomatic anyone inside negation.
changed_reading.after: The denial can also be heard distributively: not one separately countable individual will be raised, a closure echoed and contained by the final exhaustive census.

strongest_changes: Repeated ظن plus أن لن turns the focus into a reconstructable stage of epistemic recalibration rather than a static label for doubt.
The revelation-guidance-messenger chain activates يبعث as commissioning an envoy alongside resurrection.
The probe of the newly guarded sky makes divine mobilization an encountered present fact that destabilizes the categorical denial.
The promised event's unknown proximity or term exposes the move from unknown timing to never as invalid.
The closing boundary around unseen disclosure reframes the claim as unauthorized certainty about divine action.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses an epistemic error, a socially mirrored claim, and a polysemous denial of divine mobilization into one sentence. Context does not collapse those possibilities: it tests them through changed access, messenger transmission, repeated role-specific negations of anyone, and a final contrast between concealed knowledge and exhaustive divine count.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether يبعث primarily denotes bodily resurrection, messenger dispatch, or deliberately sustains both remains unresolved.
Whether focus ظن is weak conjecture or conviction from misleading indications cannot be fixed from morphology alone.
The guarded-sky scene may instantiate divine mobilization or may function only as evidence that the inherited forecast is obsolete.
The promised matter in 72:24-25 may be resurrection, punishment, defeat, or a bundle of expected outcomes.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A mirrored supposition shared across communities.** The doubled `ظنوا/ظننتم` activates ظ ن ن B003, uncertain supposition, and the comparative `كما` makes the error structurally reciprocal. `أحدا` activates ء ح د B002, exhaustive anyone. The packet supplies two groups making the same negative forecast; the inferred move is that repetition across groups amplifies a belief socially without improving its evidence. The ayah reads as diagnosis of mutually reinforced uncertainty rather than two independent mistakes.

2. **Both resurrection and dispatch remain active.** `يبعث` activates ب ع ث B001, rousing a still thing into motion, and B002/B004, dispatching and pressing onward. The object `أحدا` is formally open enough for the packet’s later material to sustain both mechanisms: 72:23-28 develops messengers and their dispatch, while promise, term, and final knowledge in 72:24-25 sustain future rousing or summons. The abductive move is only that the shared denial targeted divine initiation after apparent stillness; it does not choose which initiation. The ayah therefore retains the coexisting readings “raise anyone” and “send anyone.”
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The messenger sequence of 72:23-28 strongly reactivates dispatch (ب ع ث B002), but the promised event and bounded term of 72:24-25 keep rousing after stillness (B001) alive. Later context therefore expands rather than resolves the ambiguity.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **`كَمَا` reveals an interspecies echo chamber.** The duplicated fixed `ظ ن ن` can activate B001, certainty built from an apparent indication, and B003, uncertain supposition from weak evidence. `كَمَا` makes one group's cognition the model of the other's, while 72:5-6 has already shown speech and refuge crossing the human/jinn boundary. The packet supplies formal comparison, shared practices, and no independent warrant; I infer that repetition between groups was mistaken for corroboration. The verse reads as diagnosis of socially amplified supposition: agreement increased felt certainty without improving evidence.

2. **The event denied can be a dispatch.** Fixed `ب ع ث` B002 is sending a person or messenger toward a task. The local window opens with a recitation that guides (72:2), and the claimed certainty is already contradicted by `أُوحِىَ` and `قُلْ` in the preceding sequence, while 72:8-9 records a newly enforced information boundary. The packet supplies message, commanded speech, and dispatch branch; I infer that the event overturning their assumption is the sending of an authorized communicator. `لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا` reads as denial of intervention through even one envoy, not an abstract prediction only.

3. **A second reading retains rousing after stillness.** Fixed `ب ع ث` B001 is stirring what is still, kneeling, restrained, or sleeping into motion. The next ayat move from former stationary listening posts (`نَقْعُدُ ... مَقَاعِدَ`, 72:9) to forced displacement, then to recognition that no flight can frustrate God (72:12). The packet supplies stillness, forced movement, and exhaustive inability to escape; I infer that divine `بعث` can name the activation that ends a settled but false arrangement. The clause then reads more broadly as their belief that God would never rouse anyone into a new accountable state. This coexists with dispatch rather than resolving it.

4. **`أَحَدًا` makes the denied intervention maximally fragile.** Fixed `ء ح د` B002 exhausts "anyone" under negation and B005 distributes persons one by one. Because one heard recitation and one dispatched addressee are enough to reorganize a whole band, I infer that their universal negative can be falsified by the smallest personal instance. The ending reads as a claim of total closure that collapses when even a single authorized bearer appears.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 72:23, 72:27, and 72:28 make fixed `ب ع ث` B002 more concrete than the initial window: an approved `رَسُول` carries plural messages, is guarded through the route, and completes delivery. The final plural relay also shows how one universally denied instance under `أَحَدًا` can expand into an entire commissioned class. The rousing B001 reading remains visible because the completed dispatch reorganizes hearers and access practices.

baseline.text: Onlar da sizin sandığınız gibi Allah'ın hiç kimseyi göndermeyeceğini sanmışlardı.

findings.text: İki topluluğun aynı varsayımı tekrarlaması bağımsız kanıt üretmez; yalnızca zayıf bir kanaatin toplumsal yankıyla kesin görünmesini sağlar.
72:23-28'deki elçi ve mesaj dizisi, inkâr edilen kaldırmanın bir kimseyi görevle göndermek anlamını güçlü biçimde etkinleştirir.
Söz, durgun veya yerleşmiş bir düzenin yeniden harekete geçirilmesini de dışlamaz; bu diriltme boyutu elçi gönderme anlamıyla birlikte kalır.
Hiç kimseyi kapsayan genel inkâr, tek bir yetkili taşıyıcının ortaya çıkmasıyla bile bütünüyle çökecek kadar kırılgandır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi, nesne veya topluluğu belirli bir ihtiyaç, görev, hedef ya da yön için göndermek veya yöneltmektir. Bu işlem birini bir işi yapmaya yöneltme biçimini alabilir; gönderilmiş topluluk veya birlik adı ise işlemin sonucuna bağlı bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Bir gönderici, başka bir katılımcıyı belirli bir ihtiyaç, görev, yön veya hedef doğrultusunda yollar.

concept_map.definition: Olumsuz bir cümlede, söz konusu olabilecek kişilerden bir tekinin bile bulunmadığını ya da eyleme katılmadığını bildirir. Kapsam yalnız bir kişiyi değil, iki ve daha çok kişiyi de dışarıda bırakır.

facets.statement: Olumsuzluk altında konuşmaya konu olabilecek kişiler türünün tamamını kapsar.
